subject.title: feat(macos): Quick Chat power features — voice dictation, paste-to-app, model/reasoning control

question: Should Quick Chat ship the combined permission-gated cross-app paste and persistent session-model control as one macOS product surface once the dictation privacy contract is fixed?
rationale: The branch introduces three user-facing capabilities, including accessibility-mediated cross-app automation and a session-persistent model selector; repository policy treats permission, persisted preference, and setup behavior as compatibility-sensitive product decisions.

options.title: Approve the bounded macOS feature set
options.body: Land after enforcing the on-device dictation promise and adding real native evidence for all three user-visible flows.

options.title: Split the feature set
options.body: Land dictation and paste separately from the session-model control if maintainers want persistent-model UX reviewed independently.

options.title: Defer persistent controls
options.body: Keep the existing Quick Chat behavior and revisit model/session controls through a dedicated product proposal.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded macOS feature set
recommendation.body: Land after enforcing the on-device dictation promise and adding real native evidence for all three user-visible flows.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history identifies steipete as the active author of this macOS Quick Chat implementation, although current-main ownership could not be independently traced.
